summary: `pnpm env:render` writes every value as a single-quoted shell literal (`NAME='…'`, an embedded `'` written `'\''`), re-parses each line it emits, and refuses a value carrying a line break instead of emitting a file that half-loads.
reader_impact: An operator sourcing a rendered file — or anything under `bin/withenv.sh` — now gets `DATABASE_URL` at full length instead of unset, because an unquoted Neon URL ends the shell assignment at its `&`.
